description: This file contains the definition of the 'Event' class in the 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Startup' namespace. The class is responsible for initializing and registering system events from the database in the OpenCart admin system during startup.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A controller class responsible for loading and registering events during system startup, based on configuration stored in the database.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads event configurations from the database and registers active events with their corresponding actions during the startup process.
